decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): The release-note line is truncated [ev-4d5a8d4c450d], but the linked PR states the change concretely. The subject is the application controller's Dynamic Cluster Distribution sharding. The bug: when the shard configmap `argocd-app-controller-shard-cm` exists and there is more than one replica, a controller pod restarted by an image update or eviction gets shard number -1. That shard then processes no applications, and the applications get stuck in refreshing [ev-216c1792aec9]. The fix makes the readiness health check update `clusterSharding.shard` and `liveStateCache.clusterSharding.shard` when the shard number has changed, then resync all applications [ev-fc6423b07d19]. The changed files are all in controller sharding and cache code [ev-264f7cba20c6]. Together this is enough to write the subject, the change (a behaviour fix), who is exposed (dynamic distribution with the shard configmap and replicas > 1) and the consequence (on a pod restart, that shard's applications stop being processed).
